title: Mequon-Thiensville district reports 55 Net Promoter Score in family survey
text:
Schools
Mequon-Thiensville district reports 55 Net Promoter Score in family survey
MTSD's September family survey found an overall Net Promoter Score of 55, matching last year's rating.
The Mequon-Thiensville School District reported an overall Net Promoter Score of 55 from its 2026 September Family Survey, matching last year's rating, according to the district's October Momentum family newsletter, posted Wednesday, Oct. 28.
The district said elementary families accounted for 60% of all survey responses. According to the district, 86% of new families said they enrolled because of the district's academic reputation, and 93% reported their children feel safe at school. The district also said 88% of families felt well-prepared and welcomed before their first day, and 85% of families transitioning to new buildings said orientation eased the move.
Separately, the newsletter said the district has launched a Long-Range Facilities Master Planning process. According to the district, the process will assess how classrooms and shared spaces support modern teaching practices and evaluate building capacity and section needs, including spatial capacity at Oriole Lane Elementary School, using updated demographic data.
The district said the planning process also includes creating a 10-year maintenance plan for building mechanical systems such as HVAC, electrical and plumbing, along with structural envelopes and safety infrastructure. The district said it will model financial scenarios intended to ensure operational stability across school environments and will integrate high school athletic facility planning into its broader districtwide facility schedule.
The newsletter also noted that the district has approved calendars for the 2027-28 school year, though no further details were provided. The newsletter included additional items from the Mequon-Thiensville Education Foundation, the Mequon-Thiensville Recreation Department, Aramark food service menus for November, and job postings for substitute and long-term teaching positions at Steffen Middle School, Donges Bay Elementary School and Homestead High School.
Source: Oriole Lane Elementary School, https://oriole-lane.mtsd.k12.wi.us/index.php?pageID=smartSiteFeed&psqFeed=true&articleID=94611391
